scope: Targeted primary-source search for individual Future Saga Chapter 3 and Chapter 4 move names.

findings.chapter_3: Official Bandai Namco and Nintendo material confirms six new moves for Chapter 3 but the reviewed text does not individually name them.
findings.chapter_4: Official Bandai Namco and Nintendo material confirms four new moves for Chapter 4, including one Awoken Skill, but the reviewed text does not individually name them.
findings.exact_name_search: No directly searchable primary-source result was found for the ten individual skill names audited in batches 555 and 556.

boundary: Event-level official evidence and individual-skill independent evidence remain separate.
